dashboards.name: Serena Launch · website traffic
dashboards.description: Website page views, visitor estimates, sessions and acquisition for serenatan.org and Launch. Known automation, test events and marked internal people are excluded. Visitor IDs begin as browser IDs and can merge after sign-in; they are not verified humans. Coverage starts at release.

insights.name: Website · PV, visitors and sessions

source.query: SELECT count() AS page_views, uniqExact(person_id) AS visitors, uniqExact(properties.session_id) AS sessions, uniqExactIf(person_id, properties.visitor_type = 'new') AS new_visitors, uniqExactIf(person_id, properties.visitor_type = 'returning') AS returning_visitors FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'serena-launch' AND properties.is_test = false AND coalesce(person.properties.$internal_or_test_user, false) = false AND {filters} AND event = 'page_viewed' AND properties.traffic_type = 'browser'

insights.description: Home and Launch pages, selected range (30 days by default). Visitor estimates use PostHog identities, initially random browser IDs and merged after sign-in; they are not verified humans. Storage clearing can inflate counts. Sessions expire after 30 minutes inactivity. New/returning categories may overlap during the period.

insights.name: Website · daily page views and visitors
insights.description: Daily visitor estimates after known automation, internal accounts and test events are excluded. Not a guarantee that all sophisticated bots are removed. New event coverage starts at this release; no backfilled history.

insights.name: Website · pages

source.query: SELECT properties.page AS page, count() AS page_views, uniqExact(person_id) AS visitors, uniqExact(properties.session_id) AS sessions FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'serena-launch' AND properties.is_test = false AND coalesce(person.properties.$internal_or_test_user, false) = false AND {filters} AND event = 'page_viewed' AND properties.traffic_type = 'browser' GROUP BY page ORDER BY page_views DESC

insights.description: Separate portfolio homepage / and Launch /launchvideo/. Private consent/settings routes and asset requests are not page views.

insights.name: Website · session acquisition

source.query: SELECT acquisition, count() AS sessions, uniqExact(browser) AS visitors FROM (SELECT properties.session_id AS session, any(person_id) AS browser, argMin(coalesce(nullIf(properties.utm_source, ''), nullIf(properties.referrer_host, ''), 'Direct'), timestamp) AS acquisition FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'serena-launch' AND properties.is_test = false AND coalesce(person.properties.$internal_or_test_user, false) = false AND {filters} AND event = 'page_viewed' AND properties.traffic_type = 'browser' GROUP BY session) GROUP BY acquisition ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 30

insights.description: UTM source or referrer hostname from the first observed page view in each session; otherwise Direct. Query strings and referrer paths are not collected.

insights.name: Website · campaigns

source.query: SELECT properties.utm_source AS source, properties.utm_medium AS medium, properties.utm_campaign AS campaign, uniqExact(properties.session_id) AS sessions, uniqExact(person_id) AS visitors FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'serena-launch' AND properties.is_test = false AND coalesce(person.properties.$internal_or_test_user, false) = false AND {filters} AND event = 'page_viewed' AND properties.traffic_type = 'browser' AND notEmpty(properties.utm_source) GROUP BY source,medium,campaign ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 30

insights.description: Allowlisted UTM labels only. Missing campaigns are not inferred.

insights.name: Website · known automation, kept separate
insights.description: webdriver and recognized crawler/headless user agents. No raw user-agent string or IP is stored by this instrumentation. Bots that never run JavaScript require Cloudflare request analytics.

insights.name: Website · traffic measurement audit

source.query: SELECT properties.traffic_type AS traffic_type, properties.is_test AS is_test, count() AS page_views FROM events WHERE properties.app='serena-launch' AND event='page_viewed' AND {filters} GROUP BY traffic_type,is_test ORDER BY page_views DESC

insights.description: Diagnostic intentionally includes QA to prove the production exclusion. Use the other website cards for product traffic.

dashboards.name: Serena Launch · MCP traffic
dashboards.description: Separate HTTP ingress from tool executions, verified active accounts and activation. Excludes test events and marked internal accounts. PostHog is best effort; compare all HTTP requests with Cloudflare Worker Metrics.

insights.name: MCP · end-to-end account trace
insights.description: Latest 400 observed steps, using the same account label as Connection to first use. Linked browser activity, consent, authenticated requests, replies, tool use and agent reports. Request IDs link new calls. Clerk Application Logs show verified OAuth grants and failures.

source.query:
WITH trace_events AS (
  SELECT timestamp, event, distinct_id, properties
  FROM events
  WHERE events.properties.app = 'serena-launch'
  AND events.properties.is_test = false
  AND coalesce(events.properties.traffic_type, '') != 'automation'
  AND coalesce(person.properties.$internal_or_test_user, false) = false
  AND {filters}
  AND (
    event IN ('page_viewed', 'reference_opened', 'reference_played', 'reference_engaged',
      'reference_prompt_copied', 'reference_failed', 'collection_filtered', 'setup_prompt_copied', 'quick_connect_clicked',
      'consent_viewed', 'consent_submitted', 'consent_failed', 'mcp_rpc_completed', 'mcp_tool_completed',
      'launch_task_started', 'launch_task_completed', 'launch_task_failed', 'reference_feedback')
    OR (event = 'mcp_request_completed' AND events.properties.authenticated = true)
  )
), account_links AS (
  SELECT person_id, any(distinct_id) AS account_id
  FROM person_distinct_ids
  WHERE startsWith(distinct_id, 'account:')
  GROUP BY person_id
  HAVING uniqExact(distinct_id) = 1
)
SELECT
  timestamp AS at,
  substring(hex(MD5(if(startsWith(events.distinct_id, 'account:'), events.distinct_id, coalesce(linked.account_id, '')))), 1, 10) AS account,
  multiIf(
    event = 'page_viewed', 'Page visited',
    event = 'reference_opened', 'Reference opened on web',
    event = 'reference_played', 'Reference playback started',
    event = 'reference_engaged', 'Reference watched on web',
    event = 'reference_prompt_copied', 'Reference prompt copied',
    event = 'reference_failed', 'Reference playback failed',
    event = 'collection_filtered', 'Collection filtered',
    event = 'setup_prompt_copied', 'Setup prompt copied',
    event = 'quick_connect_clicked', 'Connect clicked',
    event = 'consent_viewed', 'Signed-in consent viewed',
    event = 'consent_submitted', 'Consent submitted',
    event = 'consent_failed', 'Consent page error',
    event = 'mcp_request_completed', 'Authenticated MCP HTTP response',
    event = 'mcp_rpc_completed', 'MCP protocol reply',
    event = 'mcp_tool_completed', 'MCP tool execution',
    event = 'launch_task_started', 'Creation started (reported)',
    event = 'launch_task_completed', 'Creation completed (reported)',
    event = 'launch_task_failed', 'Creation failed (reported)',
    'Reference feedback'
  ) AS step,
  if(startsWith(events.distinct_id, 'account:'), coalesce(events.properties.source, ''), 'linked browser') AS source,
  events.properties.client AS client,
  arrayStringConcat(arrayFilter(value -> notEmpty(value), [
    coalesce(toString(events.properties.page), ''),
    coalesce(toString(events.properties.utm_source), toString(events.properties.referrer_host), ''),
    coalesce(toString(events.properties.tool), toString(events.properties.rpc_method), ''),
    coalesce(concat('HTTP ', toString(events.properties.status_code)), ''),
    coalesce(toString(events.properties.outcome), toString(events.properties.decision), toString(events.properties.rating), ''),
    coalesce(toString(events.properties.error_kind), toString(events.properties.reason), ''),
    coalesce(concat('matches ', toString(events.properties.result_count)), '')
  ]), ' · ') AS detail,
  coalesce(toString(events.properties.reference_id), toString(events.properties.reference_ids)) AS references,
  events.properties.checks_passed AS delivery_checks_passed,
  if(notEmpty(coalesce(events.properties.task_id, '')), substring(hex(MD5(events.properties.task_id)), 1, 10), NULL) AS task,
  events.properties.rpc_request_id AS request
FROM trace_events AS events
LEFT JOIN person_distinct_ids AS ids ON ids.distinct_id = events.distinct_id
LEFT JOIN account_links AS linked ON linked.person_id = ids.person_id
WHERE notEmpty(if(startsWith(events.distinct_id, 'account:'), events.distinct_id, coalesce(linked.account_id, '')))
  AND if(startsWith(events.distinct_id, 'account:'), events.distinct_id, coalesce(linked.account_id, '')) NOT IN (
    SELECT distinct_id FROM person_distinct_ids WHERE person.properties.$internal_or_test_user = true
  )
ORDER BY at DESC
LIMIT 400

insights.name: MCP · creation task trace
insights.description: Verified account and exact task ID connect searches, lookups and the outcome. Older lookups without task IDs stay in the account trace. References and delivery checks are agent reported. A missing outcome in the selected dates remains pending.

source.query:
SELECT
  substring(hex(MD5(distinct_id)), 1, 10) AS account,
  substring(hex(MD5(properties.task_id)), 1, 10) AS task,
  nullIf(minIf(timestamp, event = 'launch_task_started'), toDateTime(0)) AS started_at,
  countIf(event = 'mcp_tool_completed' AND properties.tool = 'search_launch_videos') AS linked_searches,
  groupUniqArrayIf(properties.reference_id,
    event = 'mcp_tool_completed' AND properties.tool = 'get_launch_video' AND properties.reference_found = true) AS linked_retrieved_refs,
  argMaxIf(coalesce(properties.reference_ids, ''), timestamp,
    event IN ('launch_task_started', 'launch_task_completed', 'launch_task_failed')
    AND notEmpty(coalesce(properties.reference_ids, ''))) AS reported_refs,
  countIf(event = 'mcp_rpc_completed' AND properties.outcome IN ('tool_error','protocol_error')) AS failed_calls,
  argMaxIf(event, timestamp, event IN ('launch_task_completed', 'launch_task_failed')) AS terminal,
  multiIf(
    terminal = 'launch_task_completed', 'Completed (agent reported)',
    terminal = 'launch_task_failed', 'Failed (agent reported)',
    started_at IS NOT NULL, 'Awaiting outcome',
    'Task observed; start outside range or missing'
  ) AS status,
  nullIf(maxIf(timestamp, event IN ('launch_task_completed', 'launch_task_failed')), toDateTime(0)) AS outcome_at,
  if(terminal = 'launch_task_completed',
    argMaxIf(properties.checks_passed, timestamp, event = 'launch_task_completed'), NULL) AS delivery_checks_passed,
  if(terminal = 'launch_task_completed',
    argMaxIf(concat(
      'HTML ', multiIf(properties.html = true, 'pass', properties.html = false, 'fail', 'unreported'), ' · ',
      'source ', multiIf(properties.source_code = true, 'pass', properties.source_code = false, 'fail', 'unreported'), ' · ',
      'MP4 ', multiIf(properties.mp4 = true, 'pass', properties.mp4 = false, 'fail', 'unreported'), ' · ',
      'music ', multiIf(properties.music = true, 'pass', properties.music = false, 'fail', 'unreported'), ' · ',
      'playback ', multiIf(properties.playback = true, 'pass', properties.playback = false, 'fail', 'unreported'), ' · ',
      'download ', multiIf(properties.download = true, 'pass', properties.download = false, 'fail', 'unreported')
    ), timestamp, event = 'launch_task_completed'), NULL) AS reported_delivery_checks,
  max(timestamp) AS last_seen
FROM events
WHERE properties.app = 'serena-launch'
  AND properties.is_test = false
  AND coalesce(person.properties.$internal_or_test_user, false) = false
  AND startsWith(distinct_id, 'account:')
  AND distinct_id NOT IN (
    SELECT distinct_id FROM person_distinct_ids WHERE person.properties.$internal_or_test_user = true
  )
  AND {filters}
  AND notEmpty(coalesce(properties.task_id, ''))
  AND event IN ('launch_task_started', 'launch_task_completed', 'launch_task_failed', 'mcp_tool_completed', 'mcp_rpc_completed')
GROUP BY distinct_id, properties.task_id
ORDER BY last_seen DESC
LIMIT 100

insights.name: MCP · connection to first use
insights.description: One row per account and client in the selected dates. Shows tool listing, first call, success and first reference retrieval. Earlier tool-list events only confirm HTTP 2xx. No call means no tool call reached Serena Launch in this window. A caller can return later. Marked internal accounts and QA events are excluded.

source.query:
SELECT
  account, client,
  multiIf(
    first_reference_at IS NOT NULL, 'Reference retrieved',
    first_success_at IS NOT NULL, 'Tool succeeded',
    call_failed > 0, 'Tool call failed',
    first_call_at IS NOT NULL, 'Call received, outcome unavailable',
    first_tool_list_at IS NOT NULL, 'Tool list returned, no call',
    list_failed > 0, 'Tool listing failed',
    'Authenticated, no tool list'
  ) AS stage,
  first_tool_list_at, first_call_at, first_success_at, first_reference_at,
  if(first_call_at >= first_tool_list_at, dateDiff('second', first_tool_list_at, first_call_at), NULL) AS seconds_to_first_call,
  call_failed > 0 AS saw_call_error,
  last_seen_at
FROM (
  SELECT
    substring(hex(MD5(distinct_id)), 1, 10) AS account,
    coalesce(properties.client, 'other') AS client,
    nullIf(minIf(timestamp,
      properties.rpc_method = 'tools/list'
      AND ((event = 'mcp_rpc_completed' AND properties.outcome = 'success')
        OR (event = 'mcp_request_completed' AND properties.status_code BETWEEN 200 AND 299
          AND empty(coalesce(properties.rpc_request_id, ''))))
    ), toDateTime(0)) AS first_tool_list_at,
    nullIf(minIf(timestamp,
      properties.rpc_method = 'tools/call' OR event = 'mcp_tool_completed'
    ), toDateTime(0)) AS first_call_at,
    nullIf(minIf(timestamp,
      properties.outcome = 'success'
      AND (event = 'mcp_tool_completed' OR (event = 'mcp_rpc_completed' AND properties.rpc_method = 'tools/call'))
    ), toDateTime(0)) AS first_success_at,
    nullIf(minIf(timestamp,
      event = 'mcp_tool_completed' AND properties.outcome = 'success'
      AND properties.tool = 'get_launch_video' AND properties.reference_found = true
    ), toDateTime(0)) AS first_reference_at,
    countIf(
      (event = 'mcp_tool_completed' AND properties.outcome = 'error')
      OR (properties.rpc_method = 'tools/call'
        AND (properties.status_code >= 400 OR properties.outcome IN ('tool_error', 'protocol_error')))
    ) AS call_failed,
    countIf(properties.rpc_method = 'tools/list'
      AND (properties.status_code >= 400 OR properties.outcome IN ('tool_error', 'protocol_error'))) AS list_failed,
    max(timestamp) AS last_seen_at
  FROM events
  WHERE properties.app = 'serena-launch'
  AND properties.is_test = false
  AND coalesce(person.properties.$internal_or_test_user, false) = false
  AND distinct_id NOT IN (
    SELECT distinct_id FROM person_distinct_ids WHERE person.properties.$internal_or_test_user = true
  )
  AND startsWith(distinct_id, 'account:')
  AND {filters}
    AND ((event = 'mcp_request_completed' AND properties.authenticated = true)
      OR event IN ('mcp_tool_completed', 'mcp_rpc_completed'))
  GROUP BY distinct_id, client
)
ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC
LIMIT 100

insights.name: MCP · tool and connection errors
insights.description: Groups tool-list and tool-call attempts by their server response. An MCP error can arrive inside HTTP 200. Outcome unavailable means a request was observed and a matching response was not recorded in the selected dates. Coverage starts with response instrumentation. No raw tool arguments or error messages.

source.query:
SELECT client, rpc_method, tool,
  multiIf(rpc_outcome != '', rpc_outcome, status_code >= 400, 'http_error', 'outcome_unavailable') AS outcome,
  error_kind, nullIf(status_code, 0) AS http_status,
  count() AS attempts, uniqExact(account) AS accounts, max(last_seen) AS last_seen_at
FROM (
  SELECT distinct_id AS account,
    properties.rpc_request_id AS trace_id,
    coalesce(properties.client, 'other') AS client,
    properties.rpc_method AS rpc_method,
    coalesce(properties.tool, '') AS tool,
    maxIf(toInt64OrZero(toString(properties.status_code)), event = 'mcp_request_completed') AS status_code,
    anyIf(coalesce(properties.outcome, ''), event = 'mcp_rpc_completed') AS rpc_outcome,
    anyIf(coalesce(properties.error_kind, ''), event = 'mcp_rpc_completed') AS error_kind,
    max(timestamp) AS last_seen
  FROM events
  WHERE properties.app = 'serena-launch'
  AND properties.is_test = false
  AND coalesce(person.properties.$internal_or_test_user, false) = false
  AND distinct_id NOT IN (
    SELECT distinct_id FROM person_distinct_ids WHERE person.properties.$internal_or_test_user = true
  )
  AND startsWith(distinct_id, 'account:')
  AND {filters}
    AND event IN ('mcp_request_completed', 'mcp_rpc_completed')
    AND notEmpty(coalesce(properties.rpc_request_id, ''))
  GROUP BY account, trace_id, client, rpc_method, tool
)
WHERE rpc_outcome != 'success'
GROUP BY client, rpc_method, tool, outcome, error_kind, http_status
ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC
LIMIT 100

insights.name: MCP · HTTP request status

source.query: SELECT properties.status_code AS status, properties.http_method AS method, properties.authenticated AS authenticated, count() AS requests, round(avg(properties.duration_ms),1) AS average_response_ms FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'serena-launch' AND properties.is_test = false AND coalesce(person.properties.$internal_or_test_user, false) = false AND {filters} AND event='mcp_request_completed' GROUP BY status,method,authenticated ORDER BY requests DESC

insights.description: HTTP ingress including OPTIONS, authorization challenges (401), rate limits (429) and server errors. A 401 challenge can be a normal OAuth discovery step. HTTP 200 does not imply tool success. Time is to response headers, not entire streamed body.

insights.name: MCP · daily HTTP requests and tool calls
insights.description: Requests and executed tools are different volumes: initialize, tools/list and HTTP transport requests are not tool usage. Best-effort PostHog ingestion; Cloudflare Worker Metrics is the infrastructure source for all requests.

insights.name: MCP · active accounts and successful reference users

source.query: SELECT uniqExact(distinct_id) AS accounts_using_tools, count() AS tool_calls, countIf(properties.outcome='error') AS tool_errors, uniqExactIf(distinct_id, properties.tool='get_launch_video' AND properties.reference_found=true AND properties.outcome='success') AS activated_accounts FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'serena-launch' AND properties.is_test = false AND coalesce(person.properties.$internal_or_test_user, false) = false AND {filters} AND event='mcp_tool_completed'

insights.description: Only accounts from verified OAuth tokens. Browser visitors and service:mcp transport events are never counted as accounts. Activation means retrieving an existing reference, not rendering a finished video.

insights.name: MCP · verified clients
insights.description: Attribution comes from the verified OAuth client, never a caller-supplied runtime label. Codex metadata is recognized; some runtimes share the same client ID and unknown clients stay other.

insights.name: MCP · tool use and errors

source.query: SELECT properties.tool AS tool, count() AS calls, uniqExact(distinct_id) AS accounts, countIf(properties.outcome='error') AS errors, countIf(properties.tool='search_launch_videos' AND properties.result_count=0) AS zero_result_searches, round(avg(properties.duration_ms),1) AS average_ms FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'serena-launch' AND properties.is_test = false AND coalesce(person.properties.$internal_or_test_user, false) = false AND {filters} AND event='mcp_tool_completed' GROUP BY tool ORDER BY calls DESC

insights.description: Tools, accounts, zero-result searches and tool failures. No tool arguments, product prompts or query text are stored.

insights.name: MCP · most retrieved references

source.query: SELECT properties.reference_id AS reference, count() AS retrievals, uniqExact(distinct_id) AS accounts FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'serena-launch' AND properties.is_test = false AND coalesce(person.properties.$internal_or_test_user, false) = false AND {filters} AND event='mcp_tool_completed' AND properties.tool='get_launch_video' AND properties.reference_found=true AND properties.outcome='success' GROUP BY reference ORDER BY retrievals DESC LIMIT 50

insights.description: Reference IDs map to https://serenatan.org/launchvideo/#video-ID. Retrieval is not proof the reference was selected for a final video.

insights.name: MCP · protocol requests

source.query: SELECT properties.rpc_method AS rpc_method, count() AS requests FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'serena-launch' AND properties.is_test = false AND coalesce(person.properties.$internal_or_test_user, false) = false AND {filters} AND event='mcp_request_completed' AND properties.authenticated=true GROUP BY rpc_method ORDER BY requests DESC

insights.description: Allowlisted JSON-RPC method names only, from size-validated request bodies. No arguments, credentials, full URLs or caller-supplied account IDs.

dashboards.name: Serena Launch · adoption & outcomes
dashboards.description: Discovery, connection intent, authenticated activation, video use, explicit feedback, agent-reported outcomes and calendar D1/D7 retention. Excludes QA and marked internal people. A click/Allow is not a completed connection. Cross-browser attribution can be incomplete. Retention needs mature cohorts.

insights.name: Visitors and active accounts
insights.description: Unique browsers versus authenticated accounts; these are different populations.

insights.name: Browser discovery → watched → copy
insights.description: Ordered within 7 days. Engagement means 5 seconds actual playback. Copying a brief is not creation.

insights.name: Connection → consent → first reference
insights.description: Allow submission alone is not a connected client. Last step requires successful authenticated reference retrieval. Cross-device attribution can be missing.

insights.name: Most used clients
insights.description: Authenticated MCP calls, grouped by verified OAuth client where recognizable. Unknown client IDs stay other.

insights.name: Quick-connect choices
insights.description: Client clicks, not successful connections.

insights.name: Most used tools
insights.description: All tool executions, including errors; task reports have their own events.

insights.name: Most watched references
insights.description: Reference IDs; >=5 seconds playback, once per video per page. Not X views.

insights.name: Most retrieved MCP references
insights.description: Successful authenticated detail retrieval, not proof of use in a final video.

insights.name: Reference feedback

source.query: SELECT properties.reference_id AS reference, properties.rating AS rating, properties.source AS source, count() AS responses, uniqExact(distinct_id) AS respondents FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'serena-launch' AND properties.is_test = false AND coalesce(person.properties.$internal_or_test_user, false) = false AND coalesce(properties.traffic_type, '') != 'automation' AND {filters} AND event = 'reference_feedback' GROUP BY reference,rating,source ORDER BY responses DESC LIMIT 100

insights.description: Explicit Yes/No or explicit feedback relayed by agent. No inferred sentiment; browser/account populations can overlap.

insights.name: Reported task outcomes

source.query: SELECT event, uniqExact(concat(distinct_id, ':', properties.task_id)) AS tasks FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'serena-launch' AND properties.is_test = false AND coalesce(person.properties.$internal_or_test_user, false) = false AND coalesce(properties.traffic_type, '') != 'automation' AND {filters} AND event IN ('launch_task_started','launch_task_completed','launch_task_failed') GROUP BY event ORDER BY event

insights.description: Unique account/task pairs, agent-reported. A task with no outcome is unreported, not failed.

insights.name: Task completion and check coverage

source.query: SELECT uniqExactIf(concat(distinct_id, ':', properties.task_id), event='launch_task_started') AS started, uniqExactIf(concat(distinct_id, ':', properties.task_id), event='launch_task_completed') AS reported_completed, uniqExactIf(concat(distinct_id, ':', properties.task_id), event='launch_task_completed' AND properties.checks_passed=true) AS completed_with_all_checks, uniqExactIf(concat(distinct_id, ':', properties.task_id), event='launch_task_failed') AS reported_failed FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'serena-launch' AND properties.is_test = false AND coalesce(person.properties.$internal_or_test_user, false) = false AND coalesce(properties.traffic_type, '') != 'automation' AND {filters} AND event LIKE 'launch_task_%'

insights.description: Agent reports HTML/source/MP4/music/playback/download checks. No server render certification. Compare only matched task cohorts for rates.

insights.name: Task completion rate · matched start cohort

source.query: SELECT count() AS started_tasks, countIf(completed=1) AS completed_tasks, countIf(failed=1) AS failed_tasks, countIf(completed=0 AND failed=0) AS no_outcome_yet, round(100.0*countIf(completed=1)/nullIf(count(),0),1) AS reported_completion_pct FROM (SELECT distinct_id, properties.task_id AS task, max(event='launch_task_started') AS started, max(event='launch_task_completed') AS completed, max(event='launch_task_failed') AS failed FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'serena-launch' AND properties.is_test = false AND coalesce(person.properties.$internal_or_test_user, false) = false AND coalesce(properties.traffic_type, '') != 'automation' AND {filters} AND event LIKE 'launch_task_%' GROUP BY distinct_id, task HAVING started=1)

insights.description: Selected-window start cohort, matched by account and task ID. Unfinished recent tasks remain in denominator; no-outcome shown separately.

insights.name: Zero-result searches and tool errors

source.query: SELECT properties.tool AS tool, count() AS calls, countIf(properties.outcome='error') AS errors, countIf(properties.tool='search_launch_videos' AND properties.result_count=0) AS zero_results FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'serena-launch' AND properties.is_test = false AND coalesce(person.properties.$internal_or_test_user, false) = false AND coalesce(properties.traffic_type, '') != 'automation' AND {filters} AND event='mcp_tool_completed' GROUP BY tool

insights.description: Service errors and search gaps; no raw prompts or query text.

insights.name: Connection errors
insights.description: Fixed categories, no OAuth parameters.

insights.name: Account retention · D1 / D7
insights.description: First successful retrieval cohort; D1 and D7 are calendar days in project Pacific time. Read only mature intervals and show cohort sizes. No historical baseline.

insights.name: Returning browsers
insights.description: Browser return visits, separate from account use. Storage clearing/devices affect identity.

insights.name: References used in completed task reports

source.query: SELECT arrayJoin(splitByChar(',',toString(properties.reference_ids))) AS reference, uniqExact(concat(distinct_id,':',properties.task_id)) AS reported_completed_tasks FROM events WHERE properties.app='serena-launch' AND properties.is_test=false AND {filters} AND event='launch_task_completed' AND properties.reference_ids IS NOT NULL GROUP BY reference ORDER BY reported_completed_tasks DESC LIMIT 100

insights.description: Reference IDs explicitly named by the agent in completed task reports. Agent-reported use, separate from views or detail retrieval.

insights.name: Task outcomes and explicit feedback

source.query: SELECT properties.task_id AS task, uniqExact(distinct_id) AS accounts, max(event='launch_task_started') AS started, max(event='launch_task_completed') AS reported_completed, max(event='launch_task_failed') AS reported_failed, countIf(event='reference_feedback' AND properties.rating='helpful') AS helpful, countIf(event='reference_feedback' AND properties.rating='not_helpful') AS not_helpful FROM events WHERE properties.app='serena-launch' AND properties.is_test=false AND properties.task_id IS NOT NULL AND {filters} GROUP BY task ORDER BY reported_completed DESC LIMIT 100
